SELECT l.*, u.username, u.nickname FROM sys_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON l.create_id = u.user_id
l.log_type=#{logType} AND l.ip LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{ip}, '%' ) AND l.request_url LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{requestUrl}, '%' ) AND u.username LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{username}, '%' ) AND l.track_id LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{trackId}, '%' )
ORDER BY l.oper_time DESC

SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM sys_log WHERE dept_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT dept_id FROM sys_department WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET( #{deptId}, tree_path ) ) AND oper_time >= #{startTime} AND oper_time < #{endTime}

SELECT c.`stat_date`, COUNT( DISTINCT l.`create_id` ) AS `total_uv`, COUNT( l.`log_id` ) AS `total_pv` FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB( CURDATE( ), INTERVAL 0 DAY ) AS `stat_date` UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB( CURDATE( ), INTERVAL 1 DAY ) AS `stat_date` UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB( CURDATE( ), INTERVAL 2 DAY ) AS `stat_date` UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB( CURDATE( ), INTERVAL 3 DAY ) AS `stat_date` UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB( CURDATE( ), INTERVAL 4 DAY ) AS `stat_date` UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB( CURDATE( ), INTERVAL 5 DAY ) AS `stat_date` UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB( CURDATE( ), INTERVAL 6 DAY ) AS `stat_date` ) c LEFT JOIN `sys_log` l ON l.`oper_time` >= c.`stat_date` AND l.`oper_time` < DATE_ADD( c.`stat_date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY )
AND l.dept_id IN(SELECT DISTINCT dept_id FROM sys_department WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET( #{deptId}, tree_path ))
GROUP BY c.`stat_date` ORDER BY c.`stat_date` ASC
